program:
alphabet 0 1

is_bos = bos
is_sym0 = symbol 0
is_sym1 = symbol 1
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j, is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j | !is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(is_bos@i & is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & h1_1@i & is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j & h1_1@j | is_bos@i & !is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & h1_1@i & is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j & h1_1@j, is_bos@i & !is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & h1_1@i & is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j & h1_1@j | is_bos@i & !is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !h1_1@i & is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j & h1_1@j)
accept = is_bos & !is_sym0 & !h1_1 & h2_1 | !is_sym0 & !h1_1

output accept
